conditions: Real x and y positive; real base b positive and not equal to one.
spoken_aliases: log base b of open parenthesis x times y close parenthesis equals log base b of x plus log base b of y
the logarithm to base b of the product of x and y equals the sum of the logarithm of x to base b and the logarithm of y to base b

evidence: Set u=log_b x and v=log_b y. Then xy=b^u b^v=b^(u+v). The exponential is injective for positive b other than one, giving the stated sum.

Reference cross-check of the standard identity: https://openstax.org/books/college-algebra-2e/pages/6-5-logarithmic-properties. Checked 2026-11-27. Approval is a maintainer review candidate, not independent human certification.
